1 import SixVertexUnfolding.Geometry.CutEdgeCornerCircles
2 import SixVertexUnfolding.Geometry.CutTreeSmallLinks

7 /-! The actual triangles incident to an original tree vertex cover its
8 entire cone angle. This discharges the local geometric budget obligation. -/
9 
10 namespace SixVertexUnfolding.ConvexPolyhedron.SixVertexGraph
11 
12 open Set EuclideanGeometry
13 
14 variable {P : ConvexPolyhedron} (graph : P.SixVertexGraph)
15     (small_faces : ∀ F : P.Face, (F.val ∩ (P.vertices : Set Space)).ncard = 3 ∨
16       (F.val ∩ (P.vertices : Set Space)).ncard = 4)
17 
18 include small_faces in
19 /-- At an original vertex the actual incident triangle corners cover the full cone angle. -/
20 theorem incident_triangle_angles_cover_cone (a : frontier P.body) (T : P.CutLocusTree a)
21     [Fintype T.vertices] [DecidableRel T.graph.Adj]
22     (triangles : (d : T.graph.Dart) → CutEdgeTriangles T d.adj)
23     (u : T.vertices) (pole : Fin 6) (at_vertex : (u : Space) = (graph.vertex pole : Space)) :
24     graph.totalAngleAt pole ≤ T.incidentAngleSum (fun d => (triangles d).model) u := by
25   classical
26   letI : Fact (0 < graph.totalAngleAt pole) := ⟨graph.totalAngleAt_pos pole⟩
27   let D (v : T.graph.neighborSet u) := triangles (T.graph.dartOfNeighborSet u v)
28   choose radius positive arcs using fun v : T.graph.neighborSet u =>
29     graph.cut_edge_corner_circle_arcs small_faces (D v) pole at_vertex
30   obtain ⟨ε, ep, cone_link⟩ := graph.fanCircleMap_small_link_surjective small_faces pole
31   obtain ⟨δ, dp, triangle_link⟩ := graph.incident_triangles_cover_small_links small_faces a T triangles u
32   let V : Set ℝ := Iio ε ∩ Iio δ ∩ ⋂ v : T.graph.neighborSet u, Iio (radius v)
33   have openV : IsOpen V := (isOpen_Iio.inter isOpen_Iio).inter
34     (isOpen_iInter_of_finite (fun _ => isOpen_Iio))
35   have zeroV : (0 : ℝ) ∈ V := ⟨⟨ep, dp⟩, mem_iInter.mpr positive⟩
36   obtain ⟨R, Rp, ballV⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp openV 0 zeroV
37   let ρ := R / 2
38   have ρp : 0 < ρ := by dsimp [ρ]; positivity
39   have small : ρ ∈ V := ballV (by rw [Metric.mem_ball, Real.dist_eq, sub_zero, abs_of_pos ρp]; dsimp [ρ]; linarith)
40   choose f g boundedf boundedg coversf coversg using fun v : T.graph.neighborSet u =>
41     arcs v ρ ⟨ρp, mem_iInter.mp small.2 v⟩
42   let width : (T.graph.neighborSet u ⊕ T.graph.neighborSet u) → ℝ := Sum.elim
43     (fun v => angle (D v).model.first (D v).model.left (D v).model.right)
44     (fun v => angle (D v).model.second (D v).model.left (D v).model.right)
45   let maps : (T.graph.neighborSet u ⊕ T.graph.neighborSet u) → ℝ → AddCircle (graph.totalAngleAt pole) :=
46     Sum.elim f g
47   have covered : ∀ z : AddCircle (graph.totalAngleAt pole), ∃ i, z ∈ maps i '' Icc (0 : ℝ) (width i) := by
48     intro z
49     obtain ⟨x, _, sphere, at_z⟩ := cone_link ρ ⟨ρp, small.1.1⟩ z
50     obtain ⟨v, edge, first | second⟩ := triangle_link ρ ⟨ρp, small.1.2⟩ x
51       (by rw [at_vertex]; exact sphere)
52     · obtain ⟨q, hq, folded⟩ := first
53       refine ⟨Sum.inl ⟨v, edge⟩, ?_⟩
54       have member := coversf ⟨v, edge⟩ q hq
55       have folded_space : ((D ⟨v, edge⟩).first_triangle.homeomorph.symm q).val.val = (x : Space) :=
56         congrArg Subtype.val folded
57       rw [folded_space, at_z] at member
58       exact member
59     · obtain ⟨q, hq, folded⟩ := second
60       refine ⟨Sum.inr ⟨v, edge⟩, ?_⟩
61       have member := coversg ⟨v, edge⟩ q hq
62       have folded_space : ((D ⟨v, edge⟩).second_triangle.homeomorph.symm q).val.val = (x : Space) :=
63         congrArg Subtype.val folded
64       rw [folded_space, at_z] at member
65       exact member
66   have bound := circle_cover_length (graph.totalAngleAt pole) maps (fun _ => 0) width
67     (by intro i; cases i <;> exact angle_nonneg _ _ _)
68     (by intro i; cases i with | inl v => exact boundedf v | inr v => exact boundedg v)
69     covered
70   simpa only [sub_zero, Fintype.sum_sum_type, width, Sum.elim_inl, Sum.elim_inr,
71     ← Finset.sum_add_distrib, CutLocusTree.incidentAngleSum, D] using bound
72 
73 include small_faces in
74 /-- The inequality is independent of all choices of planar metric model. -/
75 theorem incident_model_angles_cover_cone (a : frontier P.body) (T : P.CutLocusTree a)
76     [Fintype T.vertices] [DecidableRel T.graph.Adj]
77     (models : (d : T.graph.Dart) → CutEdgeMetricModel T d.adj)
78     (u : T.vertices) (pole : Fin 6) (at_vertex : (u : Space) = (graph.vertex pole : Space)) :
79     graph.totalAngleAt pole ≤ T.incidentAngleSum models u := by
80   classical
81   let triangles (d : T.graph.Dart) := Classical.choice (graph.exists_cut_edge_triangles small_faces a T d.adj)
82   have bound := graph.incident_triangle_angles_cover_cone small_faces a T triangles u pole at_vertex
83   have same : T.incidentAngleSum (fun d => (triangles d).model) u = T.incidentAngleSum models u := by
84     apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
85     intro v _
86     have angles := ((triangles (T.graph.dartOfNeighborSet u v)).model).same_edge_corner_angles
87       (models (T.graph.dartOfNeighborSet u v))
88     exact congrArg₂ (· + ·) angles.1 angles.2
89   exact bound.trans_eq same
90 
91 end SixVertexUnfolding.ConvexPolyhedron.SixVertexGraph
